ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Ready` and runs its entry action: `entries` is 1.
The self-loop fires: `Ready` is left and entered again, so the entry action runs again (`entries` is 2) and the effect counts the press.
Another press, another exit and entry: `entries` is 3.
`press` is held, so the self-loop fires again in this tick: one more entry.
